messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look at the **long weekends** in Canada for 2023 (i.e., weekends that include a federal holiday on a Friday or Monday).  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, it’s observed on the nearest weekday, which can also create a long weekend.)

| Date Range | Holiday | Notes |
|------------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | New Year’s Day falls on Sunday Jan 1; observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario, NB, MB, PEI) | Third Monday in February (Mon Feb 20). |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a holiday on Friday Apr 7. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Third Monday in May (Mon May 22). |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | Canada Day falls on Saturday Jul 1; observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | First Monday in September (Mon Sep 4). |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | First Monday in October (Mon Oct 9). |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day falls on Friday Nov 11. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | Christmas falls on Monday Dec 25; the weekend includes Saturday Dec 23 and Sunday Dec 24. |

**Quick recap of the long‑weekend dates:**

- Jan 1–2  
- Feb 18–20  
- Apr 7–9  
- May 20–22  
- Jul 1–3  
- Sep 2–4  
- Oct 7–9  
- Nov 11–13  
- Dec 23–25  

Feel free to plug these into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, Civic Holiday in Ontario, etc.) let me know and I can add those too.
